name: Erastus
overview: Erastus was a male servant of the early church who ministered alongside the Apostle Paul. He is noted specifically for his role in assisting Paul during his missionary efforts, as recorded in the book of Acts. Scripture does not provide information about his tribal affiliation or additional personal details.
namesAndTitles: The name Erastus appears as a proper name in Scripture without a given meaning or divine origin noted. It is simply recorded as the name of a man who served in ministry with Paul.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record family relationships for Erastus beyond his role as one of the men who ministered to Paul. There are no additional relational details provided.
scriptureSignificance: Erastus is significant as a faithful minister who supported the Apostle Paul in the spread of the gospel. His mention in Acts highlights the collaborative nature of early Christian ministry and the importance of dedicated servants in advancing the mission of Christ. Though little is detailed about his life, his inclusion in the biblical record affirms his role in the foundational work of the church.
